name: Android Content Authoring
description: Writing and revising product copy, localization strings, and accessibility text for a generated Android application as ContentMutation proposals carrying a ContentRevisionDraft: terminology profile conformance, accessibility text that describes purpose, placeholder identity across locales, and dependency propagation scope. The worker proposes only; admission, validation, revision minting, and persistence belong to ContentTransactionCoordinator, ContentValidator, ContentAuthority, and ContentStore (BS §79.7; TA §85.1).
